title: Battlezone Online: BZFlag in the Browser
title_zh: 【第一行翻译】Battlezone Online：浏览器中的 BZFlag

paragraphs.en: Battlezone Online: a free 3D multiplayer tank game in the browser (desktop, phone or VR) that plays with BZFlag clients and servers.
paragraphs.zh: Battlezone Online：一款免费的 3D 多人坦克游戏，可在浏览器中运行（支持桌面端、手机或 VR），可与 BZFlag 客户端和服务器联机对战。

paragraphs.en: A free 3D multiplayer tank game in the browser -- on a desktop, a phone or a VR headset -- that plays with BZFlag clients and servers. Nothing to install.
paragraphs.zh: 一款免费的 3D 多人坦克游戏，可在浏览器中运行——支持桌面电脑、手机或 VR 头显——可与 BZFlag 客户端和服务器联机游玩。无需安装任何东西。

paragraphs.en: Play now: https://bz.rikers.org · Servers · Help: controls and flags · BZFlag Discord
paragraphs.zh: 立即游玩：https://bz.rikers.org · 服务器 · 帮助：操作与旗帜 · BZFlag Discord

paragraphs.en: https://bz.rikers.org/list lists the public bzo servers, and the BZFlag servers any of them proxies. Click a row to enter that game.
paragraphs.zh: https://bz.rikers.org/list 列出了公开的 bzo 服务器，以及其中任何一个所代理的 BZFlag 服务器。 点击某一行即可进入该游戏。

sents.en: https://bz.rikers.org/list lists the public bzo servers, and the BZFlag servers any of them proxies.
sents.zh: https://bz.rikers.org/list 列出了公开的 bzo 服务器，以及其中任何一个所代理的 BZFlag 服务器。

sents.en: Click a row to enter that game.
sents.zh: 点击某一行即可进入该游戏。

paragraphs.en: The server is Node.js; the client is Three.js, over WebSockets, WebTransport and WebRTC.
paragraphs.zh: 服务器是 Node.js；客户端是 Three.js，通过 WebSockets、WebTransport 和 WebRTC 通信。

paragraphs.en: Every published image contains linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 variants. Release tags use stable vX.Y.Z SemVer only; prerelease and build-metadata tags are not published.
paragraphs.zh: 每个已发布的镜像都包含 linux/amd64 和 linux/arm64 两种变体。 发布标签仅使用稳定的 vX.Y.Z 语义化版本（SemVer）；预发布和构建元数据标签不会被发布。

sents.en: Every published image contains linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 variants.
sents.zh: 每个已发布的镜像都包含 linux/amd64 和 linux/arm64 两种变体。

sents.en: Release tags use stable vX.Y.Z SemVer only; prerelease and build-metadata tags are not published.
sents.zh: 发布标签仅使用稳定的 vX.Y.Z 语义化版本（SemVer）；预发布和构建元数据标签不会被发布。

paragraphs.en: Docker images are built on Ubuntu 26.04 with Ubuntu's own nodejs package (Node.js 22), and CI runs on the same Node in an Ubuntu 26.04 container.
paragraphs.zh: Docker 镜像基于 Ubuntu 26.04 构建并使用 Ubuntu 自带的 nodejs 软件包（Node.js 22），CI 则在 Ubuntu 26.04 容器中运行相同的 Node 版本。

paragraphs.en: A Docker image from GitHub Container Registry, or a source tarball or git checkout. Docker is the better install and update path for most people.
paragraphs.zh: 来自 GitHub 容器仓库（GitHub Container Registry）的 Docker 镜像，或者源代码压缩包或 git 检出。 对大多数人来说，Docker 是更好的安装和更新方式。

sents.en: A Docker image from GitHub Container Registry, or a source tarball or git checkout.
sents.zh: 来自 GitHub 容器仓库（GitHub Container Registry）的 Docker 镜像，或者源代码压缩包或 git 检出。

sents.en: Docker is the better install and update path for most people.
sents.zh: 对大多数人来说，Docker 是更好的安装和更新方式。

paragraphs.en: docs/installation.md covers both, plus configuration, running behind a reverse proxy, listing your server, proxying BZFlag servers, and updating.
paragraphs.zh: docs/installation.md 涵盖了这两者，此外还包括配置、在反向代理后运行、列出你的服务器、代理 BZFlag 服务器以及更新。

paragraphs.en: A site that polls servers -- stats, a server browser -- finds what it can ask in docs/api.md .
paragraphs.zh: 一个轮询服务器的网站——统计数据、服务器浏览器——可在 docs/api.md 中查看它可以请求的内容。

paragraphs.en: /list 's Launch links open a BZFlag server in an installed BZFlag client; docs/bzflag-links.md sets up bzflag:// on Linux, Windows and macOS.
paragraphs.zh: /list 的 Launch 链接可在已安装的 BZFlag 客户端中打开 BZFlag 服务器；docs/bzflag-links.md 介绍了如何在 Linux、Windows 和 macOS 上设置 bzflag:// 协议。

paragraphs.en: bzo carries every flag BZFlag has. WA Wide Angle spawns, sticks and shakes off like any bad flag, but does nothing: it widens the field of view, and in VR the headset owns the projection.
paragraphs.zh: bzo 携带 BZFlag 中的所有旗帜。 WA 宽视角（Wide Angle）会像任何坏旗帜一样生成、附着并被甩掉，但没有任何作用：它只是扩大视野，而在 VR 中投影由头显掌控。

sents.en: bzo carries every flag BZFlag has.
sents.zh: bzo 携带 BZFlag 中的所有旗帜。

sents.en: WA Wide Angle spawns, sticks and shakes off like any bad flag, but does nothing: it widens the field of view, and in VR the headset owns the projection.
sents.zh: WA 宽视角（Wide Angle）会像任何坏旗帜一样生成、附着并被甩掉，但没有任何作用：它只是扩大视野，而在 VR 中投影由头显掌控。

paragraphs.en: docs/flags.md has the rest, including why.
paragraphs.zh: docs/flags.md 有其余内容，包括原因。

paragraphs.en: docs/controls.md has every control: the keyboard and mouse, the on-screen touch controls, gamepads, and the XR controllers. In the game, / or ? shows the keyboard's.
paragraphs.zh: docs/controls.md 包含所有控制方式：键盘和鼠标、屏幕触控、游戏手柄以及 XR 控制器。 在游戏中，按 / 或 ? 可以显示键盘控制说明。

sents.en: docs/controls.md has every control: the keyboard and mouse, the on-screen touch controls, gamepads, and the XR controllers.
sents.zh: docs/controls.md 包含所有控制方式：键盘和鼠标、屏幕触控、游戏手柄以及 XR 控制器。

sents.en: In the game, / or ? shows the keyboard's.
sents.zh: 在游戏中，按 / 或 ? 可以显示键盘控制说明。

paragraphs.en: The VR mode uses native WebXR and requires a browser and headset that support immersive-vr . For local validation, open the game at http://localhost:5154 . For remote access, serve the game over https:// -- with the server's own https certificate, or at a reverse proxy; the client automatically uses wss:// for its WebSocket connection when the page is served over HTTPS.
paragraphs.zh: VR 模式使用原生 WebXR，需要支持 immersive-vr 的浏览器和头戴设备。 对于本地验证，请在 http://localhost:5154 打开游戏。 对于远程访问，需要通过 https:// 提供游戏服务——使用服务器自身的 https 证书，或通过反向代理；当页面通过 HTTPS 提供服务时，客户端会自动为其 WebSocket 连接使用 wss://。

sents.en: The VR mode uses native WebXR and requires a browser and headset that support immersive-vr .
sents.zh: VR 模式使用原生 WebXR，需要支持 immersive-vr 的浏览器和头戴设备。

sents.en: For local validation, open the game at http://localhost:5154 .
sents.zh: 对于本地验证，请在 http://localhost:5154 打开游戏。

sents.en: For remote access, serve the game over https:// -- with the server's own https certificate, or at a reverse proxy; the client automatically uses wss:// for its WebSocket connection when the page is served over HTTPS.
sents.zh: 对于远程访问，需要通过 https:// 提供游戏服务——使用服务器自身的 https 证书，或通过反向代理；当页面通过 HTTPS 提供服务时，客户端会自动为其 WebSocket 连接使用 wss://。

paragraphs.en: A headset browser launching the installed app tries to enter VR with no 2D landing page. xr-launch.js asks for the session before the rest of the client loads, and keeps asking on each signal that could carry the user activation an immersive session needs -- window load, focus, page show, visibility change, and the Launch Handler -- with the renderer picking up whichever session results. Where none of them lands, and everywhere else, VR Mode starts from the button.
paragraphs.zh: 启动已安装应用的头戴设备浏览器会直接进入 VR，无需 2D 着陆页。xr-launch.js 在客户端其余部分加载之前就请求会话，并在每个可能承载沉浸式会话所需的用户激活的信号上持续请求——包括窗口加载、聚焦、页面显示、可见性变化以及 Launch Handler——渲染器会拾取最终得到的任意会话。 在这些信号都未成功之处，以及其他所有场景下，VR 模式都从按钮启动。

sents.en: A headset browser launching the installed app tries to enter VR with no 2D landing page. xr-launch.js asks for the session before the rest of the client loads, and keeps asking on each signal that could carry the user activation an immersive session needs -- window load, focus, page show, visibility change, and the Launch Handler -- with the renderer picking up whichever session results.
sents.zh: 启动已安装应用的头戴设备浏览器会直接进入 VR，无需 2D 着陆页。xr-launch.js 在客户端其余部分加载之前就请求会话，并在每个可能承载沉浸式会话所需的用户激活的信号上持续请求——包括窗口加载、聚焦、页面显示、可见性变化以及 Launch Handler——渲染器会拾取最终得到的任意会话。

sents.en: Where none of them lands, and everywhere else, VR Mode starts from the button.
sents.zh: 在这些信号都未成功之处，以及其他所有场景下，VR 模式都从按钮启动。

paragraphs.en: A saved name joins immediately, and without one the XR menu opens on a Join screen carrying the same name, team, and tank choices as the 2D entry dialog, so nothing waits on a screen the player cannot see.
paragraphs.zh: 已保存的名称可立即加入；若没有名称，XR 菜单会在 Join 界面打开，该界面提供与 2D 进入对话框相同的名称、队伍和坦克选项，因此不会让任何内容停留在玩家看不到的界面上等待。

paragraphs.en: Typing in XR uses the headset's own system keyboard, raised when the Name or MOTD row takes focus. Quest Browser 26.1 and later provide one; a headset that does not marks those rows Desktop only, and the player can still join under the name the server assigns. Each time the keyboard opens it starts a fresh edit, so the first key replaces the whole field rather than appending to it.
paragraphs.zh: 在 XR 中输入使用头显自带的系统键盘，当 Name（名称）或 MOTD（公告）行获得焦点时会弹出该键盘。 Quest Browser 26.1 及更高版本提供系统键盘；不提供的头显会将这些行标记为仅限桌面端（Desktop only），玩家仍可以使用服务器分配的名称加入。 每次键盘打开时都会开始一次全新的编辑，因此第一个按键会替换整个字段内容，而不是在原有内容后追加。

sents.en: Typing in XR uses the headset's own system keyboard, raised when the Name or MOTD row takes focus.
sents.zh: 在 XR 中输入使用头显自带的系统键盘，当 Name（名称）或 MOTD（公告）行获得焦点时会弹出该键盘。

sents.en: Quest Browser 26.1 and later provide one; a headset that does not marks those rows Desktop only, and the player can still join under the name the server assigns.
sents.zh: Quest Browser 26.1 及更高版本提供系统键盘；不提供的头显会将这些行标记为仅限桌面端（Desktop only），玩家仍可以使用服务器分配的名称加入。

sents.en: Each time the keyboard opens it starts a fresh edit, so the first key replaces the whole field rather than appending to it.
sents.zh: 每次键盘打开时都会开始一次全新的编辑，因此第一个按键会替换整个字段内容，而不是在原有内容后追加。

paragraphs.en: The one-tap VR button beside the settings gear is shown only on a device with a headset, because Chrome on Android reports immersive-vr support on any phone through Cardboard; VR Mode stays in the Settings menu there.
paragraphs.zh: 设置齿轮旁边的一键 VR 按钮仅在有头显的设备上显示，因为 Android 上的 Chrome 会通过 Cardboard 在任何手机上报告沉浸式 VR 支持；因此 VR 模式在该平台上仍保留在设置菜单中。

paragraphs.en: If the deployment sets a restrictive Permissions-Policy header, allow xr-spatial-tracking=(self) . TLS is either the server's own ( https , see docs/installation.md ) or a reverse proxy's ( docs/installation.md ).
paragraphs.zh: 如果部署设置了严格的 Permissions-Policy 响应头，请允许 xr-spatial-tracking=(self) 。 TLS 要么由服务器自身提供（ https ，参见 docs/installation.md ），要么由反向代理提供（ docs/installation.md ）。

sents.en: If the deployment sets a restrictive Permissions-Policy header, allow xr-spatial-tracking=(self) .
sents.zh: 如果部署设置了严格的 Permissions-Policy 响应头，请允许 xr-spatial-tracking=(self) 。

sents.zh: TLS 要么由服务器自身提供（ https ，参见 docs/installation.md ），要么由反向代理提供（ docs/installation.md ）。

paragraphs.en: Use the WebXR validation checklist when checking a new browser, headset, or deployment. WebGPU rendering is outside the scope of this checklist.
paragraphs.zh: 在检查新的浏览器、头戴设备或部署时，请使用 WebXR 验证清单。 WebGPU 渲染不在本清单的范围内。

sents.en: Use the WebXR validation checklist when checking a new browser, headset, or deployment.
sents.zh: 在检查新的浏览器、头戴设备或部署时，请使用 WebXR 验证清单。

sents.en: WebGPU rendering is outside the scope of this checklist.
sents.zh: WebGPU 渲染不在本清单的范围内。

paragraphs.en: npm run check This runs the syntax and lint checks, a server boot check, and the test suites.
paragraphs.zh: npm run check 这会运行语法和 lint 检查、服务器启动检查以及测试套件。

paragraphs.en: CI also runs these checks on pushes and pull requests.
paragraphs.zh: CI 还会在推送和拉取请求时运行这些检查。

paragraphs.en: Commit everything first, and leave nothing behind: a tag names a tree, so an edit still sitting in the working directory when the tag goes out is not in the release -- the version says one thing and the box says another, and nobody can reproduce it from the tag. That includes work somebody else left uncommitted: review it, say what it is, and commit it, rather than tagging around it. git status is clean before preparing a release and clean again once the tag is pushed; anything still pending at the end means the release went out without it.
paragraphs.zh: 先把所有内容都提交，不要留下任何未提交的东西：标签指向的是一棵目录树，所以打标签时还留在工作目录里的修改不会包含在发布中——版本号说一回事，发布包里却是另一回事，没人能从标签复现出它。 这也包括别人留下的未提交的工作：审查它、说明它是什么，然后提交它，而不是绕过它去打标签。准备发布之前 git status 应当是干净的，标签推送之后也应当再次干净；最后还有任何待处理的内容，就意味着发布时漏掉了它。

sents.en: Commit everything first, and leave nothing behind: a tag names a tree, so an edit still sitting in the working directory when the tag goes out is not in the release -- the version says one thing and the box says another, and nobody can reproduce it from the tag.
sents.zh: 先把所有内容都提交，不要留下任何未提交的东西：标签指向的是一棵目录树，所以打标签时还留在工作目录里的修改不会包含在发布中——版本号说一回事，发布包里却是另一回事，没人能从标签复现出它。

sents.en: That includes work somebody else left uncommitted: review it, say what it is, and commit it, rather than tagging around it. git status is clean before preparing a release and clean again once the tag is pushed; anything still pending at the end means the release went out without it.
sents.zh: 这也包括别人留下的未提交的工作：审查它、说明它是什么，然后提交它，而不是绕过它去打标签。准备发布之前 git status 应当是干净的，标签推送之后也应当再次干净；最后还有任何待处理的内容，就意味着发布时漏掉了它。

paragraphs.en: Release tags are stable vX.Y.Z SemVer only -- prereleases and build metadata are not published.
paragraphs.zh: 发布标签仅采用稳定的 vX.Y.Z 语义化版本（SemVer）——不发布预发布版本和构建元数据。

paragraphs.en: npm run release:prepare -- 1.0.1 That updates:
paragraphs.zh: npm run release:prepare -- 1.0.1 这将更新：

paragraphs.en: All four go in the release commit. public/js/version.mjs is the one easy to leave behind, and a tag without it ships a client reporting the version before it.
paragraphs.zh: 这四项修改都要包含在发布提交中。public/js/version.mjs 是最容易遗漏的一个，如果打标签时没有包含它，发布的客户端就会报告旧版本号。

paragraphs.en: Then edit the new changelog section so it contains the real user-visible changes.
paragraphs.zh: 然后编辑新的更新日志（changelog）部分，使其包含真实的用户可见变更。

paragraphs.en: npm run check npm run release:check -- v1.0.1 npm run release:check:increment -- v1.0.1 Then commit, tag, and push:
paragraphs.zh: npm run check npm run release:check -- v1.0.1 npm run release:check:increment -- v1.0.1 然后提交、打标签并推送：

paragraphs.en: git add package.json package-lock.json public/js/version.mjs CHANGELOG.md git commit -m " Release v1.0.1 - short description. Closes #1 " git tag v1.0.1 git push git push origin v1.0.1 The subject describes the release rather than labelling it: the version is already in the tag, package.json and CHANGELOG.md , and git log --oneline is the one view where the subject is all there is. Name the change in a few words and reference the issue with a real closing keyword where the release finishes it, since a bare (#NN) only links.
paragraphs.zh: git add package.json package-lock.json public/js/version.mjs CHANGELOG.md git commit -m " 发布 v1.0.1 - 简短描述。 Closes #1 " git tag v1.0.1 git push git push origin v1.0.1 标题描述的是这次发布本身，而不是给它贴标签：版本号已经存在于标签、package.json 和 CHANGELOG.md 中，而 git log --oneline 是唯一只显示标题的视图。 用几个词命名这次变更，并在发布完成该问题时使用真实的关闭关键词引用该 issue，因为单独的 (#NN) 只会建立链接而不会关闭它。

sents.zh: git add package.json package-lock.json public/js/version.mjs CHANGELOG.md git commit -m " 发布 v1.0.1 - 简短描述。

sents.zh: Closes #1 " git tag v1.0.1 git push git push origin v1.0.1 标题描述的是这次发布本身，而不是给它贴标签：版本号已经存在于标签、package.json 和 CHANGELOG.md 中，而 git log --oneline 是唯一只显示标题的视图。

sents.en: Name the change in a few words and reference the issue with a real closing keyword where the release finishes it, since a bare (#NN) only links.

paragraphs.en: A release that fails its workflow is left alone. bzo is in development and not every tag produces artifacts. Fix the cause and move to the next version -- do not delete or move a published tag, and do not backfill a GitHub release for one that never built. CHANGELOG.md is the record either way, and it already carries the section for the version that failed.
paragraphs.zh: 未通过工作流的发布版本保持原样不动。bzo 仍在开发中，并非每个标签都会产出构建产物。 修复原因并进入下一个版本——不要删除或移动已发布的标签，也不要为从未构建成功的版本补建 GitHub release。 无论哪种情况，CHANGELOG.md 都是记录所在，而它已经包含了失败版本对应的章节。

sents.zh: 未通过工作流的发布版本保持原样不动。bzo 仍在开发中，并非每个标签都会产出构建产物。

sents.en: Fix the cause and move to the next version -- do not delete or move a published tag, and do not backfill a GitHub release for one that never built.
sents.zh: 修复原因并进入下一个版本——不要删除或移动已发布的标签，也不要为从未构建成功的版本补建 GitHub release。

paragraphs.en: public/js/version.mjs is written by scripts/prepare-release.mjs and verified against the tag by scripts/check-release.mjs . Do not edit it by hand, and do not reintroduce a hardcoded client version string elsewhere.
paragraphs.zh: public/js/version.mjs 由 scripts/prepare-release.mjs 生成，并由 scripts/check-release.mjs 针对该标签进行验证。 请勿手动编辑它，也不要在其他地方重新引入硬编码的客户端版本字符串。

sents.en: public/js/version.mjs is written by scripts/prepare-release.mjs and verified against the tag by scripts/check-release.mjs .
sents.zh: public/js/version.mjs 由 scripts/prepare-release.mjs 生成，并由 scripts/check-release.mjs 针对该标签进行验证。

sents.en: Do not edit it by hand, and do not reintroduce a hardcoded client version string elsewhere.
sents.zh: 请勿手动编辑它，也不要在其他地方重新引入硬编码的客户端版本字符串。

paragraphs.en: The code is AGPLv3. The assets are not all the same story.
paragraphs.zh: 该代码采用 AGPLv3 许可证。 这些素材的情况则并非全都一样。

sents.en: The assets are not all the same story.
sents.zh: 这些素材的情况则并非全都一样。

paragraphs.en: bzo ships models, textures, sounds and maps from several places: some are the BZFlag project's, used under its licence; some were made for bzo; some arrived with a contribution. A file does not inherit the repository's licence by sitting in it, and an asset whose origin nobody recorded is a question left for whoever asks next.
paragraphs.zh: bzo 从多个来源引入模型、纹理、音效和地图：有些属于 BZFlag 项目，依其许可证使用；有些是为 bzo 制作的；有些则随贡献一同到来。 一个文件并不会因为放在仓库里就继承仓库的许可证，而一件无人记录其来源的素材，会成为一个留给下一个提问者的悬而未决的问题。

paragraphs.en: What is expected of anything added here:
paragraphs.zh: 此处添加的任何内容都应符合以下预期：

paragraphs.en: Not every asset already in the tree meets that bar. Some predate the expectation and some arrived with a contribution that was worth taking on its own merits, and the intent is to reach clear, recorded licensing for every one of them rather than to pretend it is already done. If you know the provenance of something here, or you are the author of it, please say so in an issue -- that is the cheapest way this gets finished.
paragraphs.zh: 并非树中已有的每个资产都达到这个标准。 有些早于这一预期就已存在，有些则是因其本身的价值而随贡献一并带来的；我们的目标是为每一个资产达成清晰、有记录的许可安排，而不是假装这已经完成了。 如果你知道这里某个资产的来源，或者你就是它的作者，请在 issue 中说明——这是完成这项工作最省事的方式。

paragraphs.en: Maps are the same question in a different shape: a map downloaded from a server, or saved out by a client, carries no grant with it. See docs/bzw.md for the map format itself.
paragraphs.zh: 地图是换了一种形式的同一个问题：从服务器下载的地图，或由客户端保存出来的地图，本身并不附带任何授权。 地图格式本身请参见 docs/bzw.md。
